title: Disneyland 2005 Collectors Snowflake Ornament Authentic Disney Parks Pixar
descriptionText: The Disneyland 2005 Collectors Snowflake Ornament is an authentic Disney Parks Pixar collectible featuring characters from Disney's Mickey Mouse franchise. Produced in Thailand, this ornament showcases the iconic Mickey Mouse character in a festive snowflake design, perfect for decorating a Christmas tree or displaying as a special keepsake for Disney fans. The 2005 release adds a unique touch to any Disney collection, making it a sought-after item for collectors of Disney memorabilia.
